subcodes.first_line: Being hath come into existence through the Word of God, and the Word of God is made manifest through His Revelation that is the perspicuous Book and the impregnable Stronghold [3.5s]... ...All existence is begotten by the Word of God, and the Word is made manifest through His advent. He is the perspicuous Book and the mighty Stronghold. He is the Dayspring of the hidden Mystery and the Dawning Place of the treasured Name
subcodes.first_line_orig: وجود از کلمة الله موجود و کلمة الله از ظهور ظاهر اوست کتاب مبین و حصن متین
